Welcome to the NYC Department of Finance Property Modeling Site

This is as a central reference for staff working on property valuation, modeling, and analysis. It brings together key components of our ongoing modeling efforts, including:

-   [**Assessor Districts**](assessor_districts): Interactive tools and resources to understand jurisdictions for assessors by district, block and section volume.
-   [**Data Dictionary**](data_dictionary): A shared reference for data sources and variable definitions across our data resources.

If you have any questions on the content displayed on this site, feel free to reach out to boydclaire\@finance.nyc.gov or [open an GitHub issue](https://github.com/nycdepartmentoffinance/nycdepartmentoffinance.github.io/issues) explaining the request.
